body:
The problem is related to the used compatibility "potato" renderer. Works just fine with the forward+ renderer.

The compatibility renderer likely can not handle such a high batched canvas item size / count in a single update call / time from the TileMap (all the set_cell() changes are batched). Although there is no error it just does not update the canvas with the new cells.

Not sure what the actual update count limit is. Easy to test by splitting the set_cell() calls between two frames which works with the compatibility renderer while it does not work when done in a single frame.


```gdscript
extends Node2D


func _ready():
    var  cell_count: int = 0
    for i in range(-128, 128):
        for j in range(-128, 128):
            var tile_set_source_id = 0
            $TileMapLayer.set_cell(Vector2i(i,j), tile_set_source_id, Vector2i(1,0))
            cell_count += 1
           if cell_count % 10000 == 0:
               await get_tree().process_frame
```

The camera is likely only so far involved as that a more zoomed-out camera automatically results in more canvas items that need to be batched up for the update, and a camera moved forces the canvas redraw.

Just did a quick test and can confirm. Compatibility renderer shows the issue, Forward+ works without issues. Could not get it to crash though.

Edit: To clarify, everything below is in relation ot he camera zoom not changing from the default (0.1, 0.1). 

I have a feeling (from a quick test) that it somehow might be a borked calculation regarding on-screen visibility calculation (i.e. basic culling). 

I tried a few different Rendering -> Rendering Quadrant sizes:
128 -> The TileMapLayer is NEVER rendered correctly
127 -> The TileMapLayer is rendered correctly when less than 100% but more than 50% of it is inside the viewport (see video)
16 -> The TileMapLayer is rendered correctly every few "pixels"(?). Still need to check if it might be the modulo of the quadrant size or something?

Quadrant Size 127:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cb970b2c-fe63-46cd-bc2c-f118a35ccfb1

Quadrant Size 16:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4c25e039-6025-49dd-948d-9179e91f30bb

Edit: I tested with a Quadrant Size of 1 and the TileMapLayer disappears every 64 tiles (the brighter lines):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e97bf75b-8f58-4522-9273-f828260ca6d4

Edit 2: 
Some more observations: Using a Quadrant size of 2, 4, 8 all show similiar behaviour to 1. Using a Quadrant Size of 31, the first "disappearance" happens when the TileMapLayer is halfway out of the viewport and then lasts for about 31 tiles before it reappears. 

Also: Not using negative coordinates in the TileMapLayer changes the behaviour (i.e. -128, 128 to 0, 256) in some way. Still TBD. Maybe it's something to do with Quadrant Size and weird culling behaviour (if canvas_items are even culled at all)

I did some more testing and and the issue only surfaces when the TileMapLayer contains cells at coordinates <= 0.
When changing the MRP to use 1,257 instead of -128,128 everything seems to be working.
